title: Ohm's law explorer
description: Adjust V and R (or I) and watch current, power and the V–I line update; water-pipe analogy panel shows pressure/flow/restriction.

title: Circuit lab (build & solve)
description: Grid-based circuit editor with a real Modified Nodal Analysis solver. Place/remove wires, R, C, L, DC voltage/current sources, switches, diodes, LEDs, ground. Shows node voltages, branch currents (animated flow), element power, equivalent resistance between two probe nodes, and a transient mode (backward-Euler) for RC/RL circuits.

presets.kcl: one node with three branches, currents shown

title: Voltage divider (loaded & unloaded)
description: Vin, R1, R2 and optional load RL. Shows Vout, divider current, power in each resistor, loading error, and Thevenin equivalent.

title: Why power loss is about current (I²R)
description: Deliver a fixed power P to a load through wiring with resistance Rw at different transmission voltages; plots loss vs voltage and shows I²R vs V²/R confusion.

title: RLC step & natural response
description: Series or parallel RLC step response with R, L, C sliders. Computes α, ω0, ζ, classifies over/critical/under-damped, plots capacitor voltage and inductor current, shows overshoot and settling.

title: RC / RL charging & continuity
description: Square-wave or step drive into RC or RL. Shows τ, the 63%/5τ rule, and demonstrates continuity: capacitor voltage cannot jump, inductor current cannot jump. Marks initial and DC-steady-state behaviour.

params.f: Hz drive frequency for square wave (default 100)

title: Passive filter lab
description: Choose a filter topology, set component values, see the schematic, Bode magnitude/phase, cutoff/center frequency, Q, and a time-domain sine at a chosen frequency showing output attenuation and phase shift.

title: Impedance vs frequency: ideal vs real parts
description: |Z| and phase vs frequency for an ideal R, C or L and for its realistic model (resistor: series L + parallel C; capacitor: ESR + ESL; inductor: DCR + parallel winding C + core loss R). Marks the self-resonant frequency and shows where the part stops behaving like itself.

title: Decoupling network (PDN) impedance
description: Add parallel decoupling capacitors (value, count, ESR, ESL incl. mounting/via inductance) plus a bulk cap; plots combined PDN impedance vs a target impedance, showing anti-resonance peaks and why multiple values / low inductance matter.

title: Phasors, phase shift & reactance
description: Rotating phasors and time-domain sinusoids. Mode 'compare' shows two sinusoids with adjustable amplitude, frequency, phase, offset and their sum. Mode 'rlc' shows voltage vs current for a pure R, L or C at a chosen frequency (current leads in C, lags in L) with reactance readout.

title: Maximum power transfer
description: Source Vs with internal Rs drives RL. Sweep RL: plots load power and efficiency; marks RL = Rs (max power, 50% efficiency). Optional complex mode with reactances showing conjugate match.

title: Standard resistor values & tolerance
description: Pick any target value: nearest E6/E12/E24/E96 values, % error, color code bands, and a Monte-Carlo of a divider built from toleranced parts.

title: Diode I–V curve & operating point
description: Shockley equation with Is, n, temperature, series resistance and reverse breakdown. Presets for silicon, Schottky, germanium, red/blue LED, Zener. Load-line mode solves a source + resistor + diode circuit by Newton iteration, marks the operating point and region (forward, reverse, breakdown).

title: PN junction & depletion region
description: Set acceptor/donor doping and applied bias: computes built-in potential, depletion widths on each side, peak field, and plots charge density, electric field and potential across the junction. Shows how forward bias narrows and reverse bias widens the depletion region.

title: Doping, carriers & conductivity
description: Choose material (Si, Ge, GaAs, SiC, GaN), donor/acceptor concentration and temperature. Computes ni, majority/minority carriers (mass-action law n·p = ni²), mobilities, conductivity and resistivity; compares N-type vs P-type at equal doping to show why electron mobility gives N-type lower resistance.

title: BJT characteristics & load line
description: NPN or PNP Ic–Vce family curves (with Early effect), base current/Vbe control, Vcc and Rc load line, operating point, region (cut-off, forward-active, saturation), β and switching use.

title: MOSFET operating regions & load line
description: NMOS/PMOS square-law model with Vt, k'(W/L), λ. Views: output curves (Id vs Vds family), transfer curve (Id vs Vgs), and load-line (VDD, RD) with operating point. Region readout (cut-off / triode / saturation), Ron in triode, gm, and switching-use interpretation.

title: CMOS inverter / buffer
description: Voltage transfer curve with noise margins and switching threshold (kn/kp ratio), shoot-through current vs Vin, dynamic power P = αCV²f + short-circuit + leakage, and a transient view of a buffer driving a series-RC load showing which FET conducts on rising/falling edges.

title: Op-amp configurations lab
description: Pick a configuration (inverting, non-inverting, buffer, difference, summing, integrator, differentiator, open-loop comparator, Schmitt trigger). Set resistor/capacitor values, input waveform (DC, sine, square, triangle) and supply rails; optional real-op-amp effects: finite open-loop gain A0, GBW, slew rate, rail limits. Shows schematic, input/output waveforms, ideal vs actual gain, saturation/clipping and virtual-short voltages.

title: Gain-bandwidth & slew rate
description: Single-pole op-amp open-loop Bode (A0, GBW). Set closed-loop gain: closed-loop bandwidth = GBW/noise-gain shown on the Bode. Second view: sine output limited by slew rate (full-power bandwidth SR/(2πVp)) and step response rise time vs bandwidth (tr ≈ 0.35/BW).

title: Differential vs common-mode gain
description: Difference amplifier with a differential signal plus common-mode noise. Resistor mismatch slider shows how Acm grows and CMRR falls; displays Ad, Acm, CMRR (dB) and output waveforms.

title: Phase-locked loop
description: Behavioral charge-pump PLL: reference frequency, feedback divider N, VCO gain and loop bandwidth/damping. Shows VCO frequency settling to N·fref, phase error, lock time, overshoot, and the effect of a reference phase step or a too-fast/too-slow loop.

title: Current mirror
description: Two-transistor (BJT or MOSFET) mirror: set reference current and output voltage; shows output current vs Vout including Early/λ effect, compliance voltage, mirror ratio from sizing, and β error for BJTs.

title: LDO regulator
description: Pass FET + error amp + feedback divider. Sweep Vin and load current: shows Vout regulation, dropout region, efficiency ≈ Vout/Vin, pass-element power dissipation and temperature rise (θJA), quiescent current, and a PSRR-vs-frequency sketch.

title: Charge pump (switched-capacitor)
description: Voltage doubler / inverter with flying and output capacitors. Animated two-phase switching shows charge transfer; set switching frequency, C values, switch resistance and load: shows output voltage, droop (Iout/(f·C)), ripple and efficiency.

title: Single-FET bidirectional level shifter
description: BSS138-style NMOS level shifter between a low-voltage and high-voltage side with pull-ups. Toggle which side drives low or releases; shows gate-source voltage, FET state, body diode conduction and both bus voltages.

title: Buck converter (switching simulation)
description: Cycle-by-cycle time-domain simulation of a buck: Vin, duty cycle (or target Vout), L, C, ESR, fsw, load current, synchronous vs asynchronous (diode) rectification, dead time with body-diode conduction, Rds(on), diode Vf. Plots switch node, inductor current, capacitor current, output ripple, diode/low-side current, input current; detects CCM/DCM; efficiency breakdown (conduction, switching, diode, DCR, gate). Compares simulated ripple with analytic ΔI = (Vin−Vout)·D/(L·fsw) and ΔV.

title: Buck control loop & load transients
description: Averaged closed-loop buck with LC output filter (double pole), ESR zero and a type-II/III compensator. Shows loop-gain Bode with crossover and phase margin, plus the time-domain response to a load step (undershoot, overshoot, settling). Lets you push phase margin low to see ringing and instability; optional feed-forward cap.

title: Boost converter (switching simulation)
description: Time-domain boost: Vin, D, L, C, load, fsw. Shows inductor current, switch node, diode current, output ripple; ideal Vout = Vin/(1−D) vs actual with losses; input vs output current; CCM/DCM; efficiency and why diode current is pulsed.

title: LDO vs buck efficiency & power calculators
description: Mode 'compare': efficiency of an LDO (Vout/Vin minus Iq) vs a buck (loss model with fixed + conduction + switching losses) across load current and Vin, highlighting where an LDO wins (low dropout, very light load). Mode 'viio': give any three of Vin, Iin, Vout, Iout (+ efficiency) and compute the fourth. Mode 'eff': give two of Pin, Pout, η and compute the third plus loss.

title: Multiphase (interleaved) buck
description: 1–6 interleaved phases: per-phase and summed inductor current, ripple cancellation vs duty cycle, effective ripple frequency N·fsw, per-phase current, conduction-loss scaling (I²R/N), and transient response comparison.

title: PWM explorer
description: Duty cycle, frequency and amplitude of a PWM signal: average and RMS values, harmonic spectrum, RC-filtered output with ripple, and LED/motor equivalent output.

title: Rectifiers & bridge rectifier
description: AC source into half-wave, center-tap or bridge rectifier with diode drops, filter capacitor and load: output waveform, ripple (≈ I/(f·C) or I/(2fC)), diode conduction intervals and peak diode currents.

title: Peak-current-mode: subharmonic oscillation & slope compensation
description: Iterated inductor-current map for peak current mode control. Inject a perturbation and watch it decay (D<50%) or grow cycle by cycle (D>50%); add slope compensation to stabilize. Plots current waveform and perturbation ratio −(m2−ma)/(m1+ma).

params.ma: compensation slope as fraction of m2 (default 0)

title: Power sequencing timeline
description: 3–4 rails each with enable delay and soft-start ramp, power-good thresholds and a set of sequencing rules (e.g., core before I/O, I/O never exceeds core by > 0.5 V). Shows voltage traces, PG signals and rule violations; supports power-down sequence.

title: Inductor saturation & core materials
description: Choose core (air, ferrite, powder iron, nanocrystalline) and current: plots inductance vs DC current (soft vs hard saturation), and the current ramp under a voltage pulse showing the runaway slope once L collapses.

title: Inductive kick & flyback protection
description: A switch interrupts current in an inductive load. Compare no protection (huge spike set by parasitic C, ringing), flyback diode, diode + Zener, RC snubber and TVS: switch voltage, inductor current decay time and energy dissipated.

title: LiPo charge & discharge
description: Single-cell Li-ion/LiPo model (OCV vs SoC, internal resistance, temperature). 'discharge': terminal voltage vs capacity at selectable C-rates and temperatures, energy delivered, I²R heat. 'charge': CC/CV profile (current, voltage, SoC vs time) with termination current; shows why the last 20% is slow.

title: State-of-charge estimation
description: Simulated drive cycle: compares true SoC with coulomb counting (with current-sensor offset/gain error drifting over time), OCV-lookup (flat curve + IR error under load), and a blended estimator that corrects with OCV at rest.

title: Series cell balancing
description: 2–6 series cells with capacity / initial-SoC mismatch. Charge the pack with and without passive (bleed resistor) balancing: shows each cell voltage, the first cell hitting 4.2 V, usable pack capacity lost, and balancing current/heat.

title: Brushed DC motor
description: Electro-mechanical model (R, L, Kt=Ke, J, friction, load torque). 'transient': apply a voltage step: inrush/stall current, back-EMF rising with speed, current settling. 'curves': torque–speed, current–torque, power and efficiency curves with stall torque and no-load speed. PWM duty scales voltage.

title: H-bridge & half-bridge
description: Click each of the four switches (or two for a half-bridge) to turn it on/off. Highlights the current path, motor direction, coast, brake (both low-sides), shoot-through (with fault warning and current), freewheeling through body diodes after turn-off, and a dead-time timing view.

title: Stepper motor driving
description: Two-phase bipolar stepper: full-step, half-step and microstepping (sin/cos currents). Shows coil currents, rotor angle, step sequence table, and holding torque vs microstep position.

title: Hobby servo & position control
description: 50 Hz PWM pulse width (1–2 ms) maps to target angle; internal P/PD loop drives the motor toward the potentiometer feedback angle. Adjust gains to see overshoot, steady-state error and ringing.

title: Quadrature encoder
description: Rotating disk with A/B channels 90° apart: direction from phase order, 1×/2×/4× decoding, counts per revolution → RPM, and the speed measurement trade-off between counting over a window and timing between edges.

title: Current sensing chain (Rsense → CSA → ADC)
description: Choose current range, sense resistor, amplifier gain, ADC bits and reference. Computes sense voltage, power dissipated in Rsense, amplified voltage vs ADC range (clipping/headroom), resolution in mA/LSB, recommended Rsense or gain, and high-side vs low-side common-mode considerations.

title: MOSFET gate drive, Miller plateau & gate resistor
description: GPIO/driver voltage and source resistance + gate resistor into Ciss/Crss with gate-loop inductance. Shows Vgs(t) with Miller plateau, Vds and Id switching transitions, switching loss, and parasitic ringing when Rg is too small; pull-down resistor behavior when the GPIO floats.

title: High-side NFET bootstrap driver
description: Half-bridge with bootstrap diode and capacitor: shows switch node, bootstrap cap voltage charging when the low side is on, high-side Vgs = Vboot − Vsw, droop during long on-times, and the maximum-duty limitation.

title: Opto-isolator design
description: LED drive current from a GPIO resistor, current transfer ratio (CTR, with ageing/temperature), output pull-up: checks saturated low level, and shows output rise time vs pull-up value (speed vs current tradeoff).

title: Fourier synthesis & spectrum
description: Build square, triangle, sawtooth or pulse-train waves from N harmonics; shows Gibbs ringing, harmonic amplitudes (1/n for square, sinc envelope for pulse trains with duty D), and how finite rise time adds a second roll-off at the knee frequency ≈ 0.35/tr (or 1/(π·tr)).

params.tr: fraction of period rise time for trapezoid view (default 0.02)

title: Sampling & aliasing
description: Signal frequency vs sample rate: shows samples, reconstructed waveform and the apparent (aliased) frequency |f − k·fs|, the Nyquist frequency fs/2, and spectrum folding; optional anti-alias filter.

title: Transmission line reflections
description: Source (Vs, Rs, rise time) → line (Z0, delay) → load (RL, open, short, capacitive). Computes Γs, ΓL, draws the bounce (lattice) diagram and the voltage at source and load vs time; toggles series, parallel, Thevenin and AC termination.

title: Trace impedance calculator
description: Microstrip and stripline characteristic impedance (Hammerstad–Jensen / IPC-2141 style formulas) from trace width, dielectric height, copper thickness and εr; effective εr, propagation delay per length; edge-coupled differential impedance. Includes the 'substrate twice as thick' scenario.

title: Eye diagram
description: PRBS data through a lossy channel (bandwidth limit) with random noise and jitter, folded into an eye. Shows eye height/width, a mask with violations counted, and the effect of pre-emphasis/de-emphasis or CTLE equalization.

title: Differential vs single-ended signaling
description: Two lines carry +V/−V around a common-mode level; inject common-mode noise and see it cancel at a differential receiver, unlike a single-ended receiver. Shows Vdiff, Vcm, skew-induced mode conversion and ground offset immunity.

title: Crosstalk between traces
description: Aggressor edge couples into a victim trace via mutual C and L. Spacing, height above plane, coupled length and rise time set near-end (backward) and far-end (forward) crosstalk amplitude; shows the 3W rule and effect of a guard trace/ground plane.

title: Ground bounce (simultaneous switching)
description: N outputs switch simultaneously through shared package ground inductance: V = N·L·di/dt. Set N, L, load C, edge rate and decoupling; shows the bounce waveform, a false-trigger threshold on a quiet input, and mitigations.

title: Skin effect
description: Skin depth δ = sqrt(ρ/(π f μ)) vs frequency for copper, aluminium, gold, silver; AC resistance of a round wire or PCB trace vs frequency; animated current-density cross-section.

title: Ringing from parasitic L and C
description: A fast edge drives a parasitic series L into a C (trace stub, probe ground lead, gate loop). Shows ringing frequency 1/(2π√LC), damping, overshoot, and how series resistance or shorter loops fix it.

title: Digital logic simulator
description: Drag-and-drop gate-level simulator: AND, OR, NOT, NAND, NOR, XOR, XNOR, buffer, toggle inputs, output LEDs. Wire gates, toggle inputs and see outputs propagate immediately; auto-generates the truth table and a Boolean expression; detects combinational loops.

title: Truth table → K-map → minimal logic
description: Edit a 2–4 variable truth table (0/1/don't-care); renders the Karnaugh map with Gray-code ordering and prime-implicant groups; minimal SOP and POS via Quine–McCluskey; gate count.

title: Number bases, two's complement & endianness
description: Convert between binary, octal, decimal and hex with step-by-step working (repeated division / positional expansion), two's complement for signed values, bit-field with MSB/LSB highlighted, and big- vs little-endian byte layout in memory.

title: Register map decoder
description: Define register fields (name, msb, lsb) and enter a hex value: shows each field's binary and decimal value, and lets you compose a new value with mask/shift operations (with the C expression).

title: Latches, flip-flops, setup/hold & metastability
description: Edit D and CLK waveforms by clicking: compare a level-sensitive D latch (transparent while CLK high) with an edge-triggered D flip-flop. Setup/hold window shown around each active edge; D changes inside the window cause a metastable (randomly resolving, delayed) output. Also SR latch mode.

title: Finite state machines (Moore vs Mealy)
description: Step an input bit stream through a sequence detector or traffic light FSM; animated state diagram highlights the current state/transition; outputs shown for Moore (state-based) and Mealy (input-based) versions side by side to show the one-cycle difference.

title: Clock divider
description: Counter-based clock divider: divide by any N; shows counter value, output waveform and duty cycle; odd-N 50% duty using both edges; toggle flip-flop chain for powers of two.

title: ADC: quantization, SAR, flash & reading conversion
description: 'quantize': N bits and Vref vs input → code, LSB, quantization error. 'sar': step through the successive-approximation binary search bit by bit. 'flash': comparator ladder thermometer code. 'convert': code ↔ voltage converter (V = code·Vref/2^N, and the 2^N−1 convention note).

title: DAC: R-2R & binary-weighted
description: Digital code → analog output for an R-2R ladder or binary-weighted DAC, with resistor mismatch causing DNL/INL; staircase output for a ramp; LSB size and resolution.

title: Sample & hold
description: Switch (Ron) + hold capacitor + buffer. Shows tracking during sample phase (RC acquisition time to N-bit accuracy), droop from leakage during hold, charge-injection pedestal, and the trade-offs of short vs long sample times and small vs large hold caps.

title: UART framing & oversampling
description: Type a character: shows the frame (idle-high, start bit, data LSB-first, optional parity, stop bits) at a baud rate; receiver 16× oversampling locating mid-bit sample points; baud-rate mismatch slider showing cumulative sampling drift and when frames fail.

title: SPI modes & connections
description: CPOL/CPHA mode selector shows SCLK, MOSI, MISO, CS waveforms for a byte with sample/shift edges marked; topology view for independent chip-selects vs daisy-chain.

title: I²C transaction builder
description: Compose a transaction (start, 7-bit address, R/W, ACK/NACK, data bytes, repeated start, stop); renders SDA/SCL waveforms with each field labelled; toggle clock stretching by the target; explains who drives SDA in each bit.

title: I²C pull-up sizing & rise time
description: Bus capacitance, VDD and speed mode → Rp(min) = (VDD − VOL)/IOL and Rp(max) = tr/(0.8473·Cb); shows the RC rise waveform against the 30%/70% thresholds and the spec rise-time limit; flags too-weak/too-strong pull-ups.

title: GPIO: push-pull, open-drain, inputs & contention
description: 'output': push-pull vs open-drain with pull-up, showing which transistor conducts. 'input': floating vs pull-up/pull-down with leakage noise. 'contention': two push-pull drivers fighting → current through the FETs. 'debounce': mechanical bounce with RC + Schmitt or software debounce.

title: MCU timer / counter & PWM
description: Input clock, prescaler (PSC) and auto-reload (ARR) → counter sawtooth, update-event frequency f = fclk/((PSC+1)(ARR+1)), compare register → PWM duty, resolution vs frequency trade-off; solves for PSC/ARR given a target frequency with error.

title: Interrupts & ISR timing
description: Timeline of a main loop plus multiple interrupt sources with priorities and ISR durations; shows latency, nesting/preemption vs non-nested handling, pending flags, and missed events when an ISR is too long.

title: 5-stage pipeline & hazards
description: IF-ID-EX-MEM-WB pipeline diagram for a short instruction sequence; toggles forwarding, shows data-hazard stalls (load-use), branch flushes, and computes CPI vs an unpipelined design.

title: Branch prediction
description: Run static (always taken/not-taken), 1-bit and 2-bit saturating-counter predictors on a branch outcome pattern (loops, alternating, random); shows state transitions, mispredictions and accuracy.

title: Cache simulator
description: Direct-mapped or N-way set-associative cache: address breakdown into tag/index/offset, step through an address trace with hits/misses, LRU replacement and hit-rate.

title: Assembly stepper
description: Step a small RISC-V-style assembly program (loop/subroutine) instruction by instruction: registers, PC, branch decisions, instruction count and cycle estimate; counts how many times a subroutine executes.

title: Power, performance & thermals (PVT)
description: Dynamic power αCV²f + leakage (∝ exp with temperature and Vt) vs voltage, frequency and temperature; max frequency vs voltage (alpha-power delay model); DVFS operating points; thermal model (θ) with a throttling control loop.

title: Radiation upsets, ECC & TMR
description: Hamming(7,4)/SECDED code word: flip bits to simulate single-event upsets and watch syndrome decode correct single errors and detect doubles; triple modular redundancy voting.

title: IMU: integration drift & sensor fusion
description: Accelerometer bias/noise double-integrated to position drift (∝ t²); gyro bias integrated to angle drift; complementary filter fusing accelerometer tilt with gyro rate, adjustable α.

title: Light sensing: photodiode vs photoresistor
description: Irradiance → photodiode current (responsivity) → transimpedance amplifier output, bandwidth vs feedback R/C; photoresistor log-resistance response and slow time constant; side-by-side step response.

title: LiDAR time-of-flight
description: Target distance → round-trip time 2d/c; timing resolution → range resolution; return pulse with noise, ambient light and multiple returns; max range from pulse repetition rate.

title: Scope probes: compensation, loading & ground lead
description: 'compensation': 10× probe tip R/C vs scope input R/C — adjust the compensation cap to see over/under-compensated square waves. 'loading': probe input impedance (1× vs 10× vs active) loading a source impedance vs frequency. 'ground': ground-lead inductance ringing vs spring tip.

title: Oscilloscope triggering
description: Noisy repetitive signal displayed with and without a trigger: set level, slope, holdoff and mode (auto/normal/single); untriggered display rolls, triggered display stabilizes; runt/glitch example.

title: Bandwidth, rise time & sample rate
description: Signal rise time vs instrument bandwidth: measured tr ≈ sqrt(tr_sig² + (0.35/BW)²); harmonic content vs bandwidth; sample-rate view showing too few samples per edge and aliasing.

title: Sensor calibration & error
description: A sensor with offset, gain error, nonlinearity and noise vs a reference; take calibration points, fit 1-/2-/multi-point corrections, see residual error, accuracy vs precision (bias vs scatter) and averaging.

title: DMM measurements: loading, burden & 4-wire
description: 'loading': DMM input resistance (10 MΩ) measuring a high-impedance node. 'burden': shunt burden voltage in current mode. '4wire': 2-wire vs 4-wire (Kelvin) resistance with lead resistance.
